7e506b56d4e2e07a77c53b0af66767891e465a34.summary: Fraunhofer FKIE Malpedia family entry for EternalPetya, a malware family with many aliases including NotPetya, ExPetr and BadRabbit. The page lists TeleBots and Sandworm as actors and gives a long reference list running from 2017 to 2024. One cited headline reports a CIA conclusion, carried by The Washington Post in 2018, that the Russian military was behind the NotPetya attack in Ukraine. Bad Rabbit is described as a suspected variant of Petya. The page names no CVEs.

7e621fd5ba97bd5ae4c19d0f28b0b8e4e0622726.summary: Vendor blog from Trend Micro, published 2019-08-07, on digital skimming: attackers inject Magecart JavaScript into e-commerce payment pages to steal card details as they are entered. It cites a $228m UK fine against British Airways, reports 17,000 and 962 compromised sites in separate attacks, and notes a record of 57 payment gateways reached. It ends by promoting Trend Micro Security as the best protection.

actors.q: Indeed, the Magecart attackers have proven over the past year that no website is safe from skimming attacks.
